result:
Bug fixed. A malformed `model_aliases` (like `garbage`) now gets a 400 instead of hanging.

Both `_parse_model_aliases_str` and `_parse_classification_str` in `anthrouter/config.py` now raise `ValueError` instead of calling `p.error()`. They no longer take a parser argument. `parse_args()` catches the `ValueError` and calls `p.error()`, so CLI behavior is unchanged. `handle_post_config` in `anthrouter/admin.py` catches it and returns 400 `invalid_request_error`. I also fixed `auto_model_routing_classification` the same way, since it had the same bug. I did not add a test or exercise the 400 path directly.

The full suite ended with 1124 passed, 3 failed, 1 skipped. I re-ran all three failing tests with my changes stashed. The two `tests/test_handlers.py` ones failed the same way, and so did `test_editable_fields_live_editable_fields` in `tests/test_config.py`. None of the three involves the files I changed.
